title: EBM Audit local audit configuration v0.3

CsvFormat.$comment: The declared column order is the exact required CSV header order. Parsing never trims, guesses types, applies locale rules, or invents missing-value tokens.

InputSource.$comment: Complete physical input owner. Runtime requires variant.source_digest_method exact-file/1 and exact equality between expected_byte_digest and variant.source_digest; neither field is inferred. Raw variant label and provenance remain private and enter only path-free identity preimages and the sealed dataset catalog.

DevelopmentScenarioAuthority.$comment: Private local path plus exact-byte identity for the registered public development scenario authority. Only the digest enters public projections.

BackendAxisAssignment.$comment: A backend choice replaces the complete digest-bound BackendSpec. A detached /backend/settings patch is forbidden.

ComposedExperimentMember.$comment: The compiler derives the complete AnalysisSpec and analysis_spec_id. They are not caller assertions.

InfluenceDeclaration.$comment: Participant selections are compiled to private internal row indexes after input validation; direct identifiers are never configuration fields.

Randomness.$comment: The master seed is mandatory input. Resolution never generates or replaces it.

OperationRandomizationSeedPreimage.$comment: This owner exists before operation randomization. Experiment-set provenance is deliberately absent: equal complete operation tuples share a draw across origins. null_family_id is execution-semantic ownership of an independent null randomization series. A derived analysis identity or realized row/transformation manifest is forbidden here.

UniverseChainSeedPreimage.$comment: The final analysis specification already binds the realized operation. The operation kind must be recomputed from that specification before this owner is accepted.

ProductSeedPreimage.$comment: The one public-product seed owner. Ordinary and influence operations have no operation-randomization branch; their fitted analyses receive universe-chain seeds after the final AnalysisSpec exists. Evaluator-held roots and identities are forbidden.

ValidatedDatasetSummaryPreimage.$comment: Public aggregate identity only. Private row indexes and direct identifiers are forbidden by closure.

ValidatedDatasetSummary.$comment: Persisted public aggregate. Runtime recomputes summary_digest from summary under ebm-audit/validated-dataset-summary/1; possession of this record does not confer access to the prepared private table.

PreparedAuditDatasetBindingPreimage.$comment: Public aggregate binding for the identity-keyed PreparedAuditDataset capability. The private catalog and parsed table remain in the runtime registry and cannot be reconstructed from this owner.

AuditConfigPublicProjection.$comment: Exact path-free source-configuration digest preimage used transiently during resolution. It includes the complete physical DataVariant so label and provenance changes alter the source identity, but those raw strings are never copied into ResolvedPublicConfig.

ResolvedPublicConfig.$comment: This is the path-free public projection. Local paths exist only in the in-memory PrivatePathBindings.
